claim: A same id/version could be replaced after review and reuse prior Verification, approval, and ACCEPT evidence.
evidence: Prior schema bound evidence only to Artifact id/version.
The new regression changes content in place and check-records fails.
impact: A human could approve one payload while a different payload is released under the same version.
required_action: Bind Artifact identity to a canonical content hash across every final gate and runtime recovery check.

prevention.action: Artifact content_hash is required and repeated by Verification, Decision, and Approval records.
